founder.name: Supriya
founder.institution: Institute of Home Economics, University of Delhi
founder.story100Words: I started this blog during my 1st year at the Institute of Home Economics, University of Delhi, located in Hauz Khas, New Delhi. Fascinated by consumer psychology and digital culture, I observed how marketing evolved beyond traditional advertisements into witty push notifications, moment marketing, and authentic community storytelling. Through SUWIK, standing for Strategically Unified Worlds of Innovation and Knowledge, I launched this publication to analyze eight iconic campaigns, from Zomato and Swiggy to Nike and Coca-Cola. My ongoing purpose is translating academic frameworks into practical, real-world insights that empower students to master the art and science of modern brand building.

about.story100Words: I started this blog during my 1st year at the Institute of Home Economics, University of Delhi, located in Hauz Khas, New Delhi. Fascinated by consumer psychology and digital culture, I observed how marketing evolved beyond traditional advertisements into witty push notifications, moment marketing, and authentic community storytelling. Through SUWIK, standing for Strategically Unified Worlds of Innovation and Knowledge, I launched this publication to analyze eight iconic campaigns, from Zomato and Swiggy to Nike and Coca-Cola. My ongoing purpose is translating academic frameworks into practical, real-world insights that empower students to master the art and science of modern brand building.

pillars.title: Strategic Innovation
pillars.desc: Examining how nimble Indian startups and global giants disrupt customer acquisition using agile moment marketing, self-aware humor, and viral mechanics.
